## 维护者速读

工作室里的同步向导，放在“虚拟对象”向导旁边：选来源对象（表里没有就先起草）、字段映射、共享模型、频率、组织。`synced` 对象只读显示，并能看运行历史。

## Scope (ADR-0153's P3 Studio row)

- The sync wizard sits beside the virtual-object one, on `offersSync`'s page. It covers:
  - the source object, drafting it when the table has none;
  - the field map;
  - the sharing model;
  - the cadence;
  - the organization.
- Read-only rendering of `synced` objects.
- Run history from `sys_sync_run` (D7).

`Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
